# Accessible PDF fixture

This document covers the structures a tagged PDF has to carry: headings, lists, a table, images with and without alternative text, and links.

## Lists

An unordered list:

- First item
- Second item with **bold** text
  - A nested item
- Third item

An ordered list:

1. Prepare the data
2. Run the analysis
3. Write the report

## Table

| Region | Q1 | Q2 |
|---|---:|---:|
| North | 120 | 135 |
| South | 98 | 110 |
| West | 143 | 150 |
